flags.headline: They can pass your data around an unnamed group of companies
flags.plainEnglish: "Affiliates", "partners" and "corporate family" are open-ended: the list can grow without telling you.
flags.quote: We may provide information to our related companies, including parents, affiliates, subsidiaries, and other companies under common control and ownership.

decoded.meaning: Any company they own or that owns them, now or after the next acquisition.

flags.headline: They can sell or trade your personal data
flags.plainEnglish: This wording lets them hand your data to other companies in exchange for money or something of value.
flags.quote: Our business is funded through subscriptions, paid products, and sponsored content, not based on selling your personal information to third parties.

decoded.meaning: Anyone who is not you and not them: the category is unbounded by design.

flags.plainEnglish: Reviewers, moderators or contractors can open what you assumed only a machine would see.

flags.headline: Deleting your account does not delete your data
flags.plainEnglish: Copies can outlive the account: in backups, in logs, or simply for "as long as necessary".
flags.quote: We retain and use your information in connection with potential legal claims when necessary and for compliance, regulatory, and auditing purposes.

flags.headline: You give up your day in court

decoded.meaning: Disputes go to a private arbitrator instead of a court, usually with no appeal.
